voice_description: Native Japanese, standard Japanese. An adult male attendant in a dramatic fantasy anime. A practical, stern voice that gives short instructions efficiently. Firm and matter-of-fact, with clear natural diction. He sounds subordinate to the leader rather than like the main antagonist. Studio-quality recording.
